inputs.name: D1AuthStoreAdapter.constructor.db
inputs.description: The minimal database surface consumed by this adapter: prepare(query) returns a statement with bind, first, and run. Supply it when constructing the adapter or calling the factory; those methods are the required interface.

inputs.name: D1AuthStoreAdapter.purge.now
inputs.description: The numeric cutoff passed to each configured cleanup statement when purge runs. The adapter binds it unchanged and does not validate or convert its unit.

inputs.name: createD1AuthStore.db
inputs.description: The minimal database surface consumed by this adapter: prepare(query) returns a statement with bind, first, and run. Supply it when constructing the adapter or calling the factory; those methods are the required interface.

outputs.name: D1AuthStoreAdapter.purge
outputs.description: A promise that resolves after the configured cleanup DELETE statements finish sequentially. It resolves with void and can reject if a D1 call fails.

outputs.name: createD1AuthStore
outputs.description: The AuthStore interface backed by the supplied D1 binding, returned as a new D1AuthStoreAdapter. It exposes challenge, GitHub-state, exchange, session, grant, email-proof, email-ledger, and purge operations.

errors.name: Unspecified D1 error
errors.description: A synchronous exception from prepare or bind, or a rejection from run, escapes purge unchanged. D1Like does not specify the concrete error class or name.
